summary: Intraday datasets (1m/5m/15m/30m/60m) are keyed by real tz-aware bar_start per (instrument, bar_start); several bars per date no longer collide; duplicates rejected.
Annualisation uses bars_per_year = 252 x bars_per_session(frequency) (5m=13608, 60m=1260; daily stays 252); benchmark Sharpe uses the same factor.

Fills are at the NEXT bar's open (plan_intraday_orders / from_orders price=open); a signal on the last bar of a session never fills overnight unless holding=overnight; positions are forced flat at the last bar opening at or before 13:25.
Lookbacks reset at the session open by default and cross sessions only when cross_session=true is declared (recipe parameters or feature definition).

Every intraday run is labelled evidence_mode=replay (aggregate, bundle, registry metadata, dataset summary) with live_or_paper_evidence=false and the source snapshot (content sha256, sessions, bars per symbol). Replay requires an explicit availability_ceiling and clock=bar_end declaration.

build_intraday_replay_dataset reads only reconciled tw_price_1m days via the K4 loader; missing/quarantined/waived/not-yet-available data raises IntradayDataUnavailable (reason code). No daily or synthetic fallback; screen strategies fail closed on intraday.
Gross and net returns are both reported for intraday runs (costs dominate).

Alpha evaluator: INTRADAY_EVALUATION_HORIZONS=(1,5,15,30) bars; compute_intraday_ic_metrics uses open[t+1]->close[t+h] within session, labelled replay; attach_intraday_metrics reports it next to the unchanged daily 1d/5d/20d set. Unavailable data raises IntradayEvaluationUnavailable.

Review REOPEN fix 1: replay-scoped governed observation bridge (_attach_replay_minute_observations) turns bars <= i into dataset-bound tz-aware tw_price_<N>m observations; available_time is the explicit simulated bar_end clock (availability_basis=replay_simulated_bar_end) while the REAL bar_availability_ts is retained as real_available_time with source_snapshot_sha256; bars with real availability after the replay ceiling are rejected in prepare; live PIT in factor_rule is untouched; later bars are never emitted.

Review REOPEN fix 2: evaluate_single_alpha_template / evaluate_alpha_template_library take intraday_replay_dataset and attach a governed 'intraday' block (1/5/15/30-bar IC, replay) beside the unchanged daily output (omitted -> identical to before). Templates are rebound onto the minute dataset only for price/volume inputs; others report available=false.

Review REOPEN fix 3: govern_intraday_replay_dataset and compute_intraday_ic_metrics enforce reconciled source_snapshot (hash must match records), replay label/clock, availability ceiling and no quarantined/partial/waived flags; failures raise IntradayEvaluationUnavailable.

Real backend intraday supports canonical strategy artifacts only; the unbound MA-crossover path on the real backend raises for intraday.
Replication protocol (run_replication_backtest_protocol) windows remain day-based; session/trade-count thresholds belong to K6 (INTRADAY-REPLICATION-GATE-20261111).
